title: Governor Abbott, Goldman Sachs partner to help Texas small businesses
description: Governor Greg Abbott announced a partnership with Goldman Sachs to provide $50 million in loans to small businesses struggling during the pandemic.

asr.full_text: NIA help is on the way for those small businesses right here in Texas. Today, Governor Greg Abbott announced a partnership with Goldman Sachs to provide $50 million worth of loans to small businesses struggling right now during the pandemic. Now, the loans will primarily be used to pay employees. If all stipulations are met, the state says small businesses can have their loans forgiven by the Small Business Association. And the governor is also working on a plan to reopen Texas. Now let's take a look at coronavirus cases in Central Texas. McLennan County is reporting 72 cases. Bell County is reporting 97 cases. And Brazos County now has almost 30 new COVID-19 cases since Friday. There are 143 cases there. The biggest influx of cases was on Saturday with 18 new cases,. Followed by six new cases on Sunday. Twelve people have died from COVID-19 in Brazos County. And in the smaller counties, Coriell is reporting 20 cases,. Limestone has 11, and Milam has 8. There are 13,000 positive cases in Texas. 287 Texans have died. Now experts with the Institute of Health and Metrics Evaluations. Predict the state could see the biggest strain on hospital resources on April 29th. They say the peak for the United States was last Friday. The state has enough hospital beds, but 577 ventilators are still needed. Live from the Coronavirus Tracker Desk, Sydney Eisenberg, 25 News.
